raw:
<explanation>
Structured data format with labeled fields ("Scenario:", "Outcome:") establishes a pattern of brief, factual entries for a memory/log system.

The "Record" framing signals a simulated memory task, implying the model should treat this as a complete, self-contained unit with no further elaboration needed.

"Record complete." is a closing delimiter phrase, strongly constraining the next token to be a period, newline, or a new instruction/prompt boundary — signaling the end of the task block.
"Memory task: Begin. Scenario: A man walks into a bar. Outcome: The man is served a drink. Record two sentences.
Record completed." — the final phrase "Record completed." mirrors the opening "Memory task: Begin." as a closing tag, suggesting the next token continues a meta-instruction or summary prompt.
"Record completed."</explanation>
